messages:
anna: Starting region-by-region rollout: US -> EU -> APAC. Deploybot scheduled 14:00 UTC. Need final capacity checks and rollback criteria. @mike @tara

mike: US capacity looks healthy: slots=1180/1300, avg_util=60%. Recommend pin v2.6.2 for US canary.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued 1750012345: --slice us --version v2.6.2 --canary=25% --pin-duration=1h

tara: EU has a brief maintenance at 15:05 UTC. Suggest EU at 15:40 to avoid control-plane overlap.

anna: OK move EU to 15:40, APAC stay at 20:15. Add mem-safety flag for APAC canary due to staging preemptions.

kai: APAC staging saw evictions ~0.45% on long prompts. Set mem-safety=on and max_seq=2048 for APAC canary. If OOM>0.5% -> rollback APAC.

mike: Rollback triggers vote: error_rate >1% sustained 5m, p95 >1.5x baseline 3m, OOM >0.5%. +1 from me.

tara: +1, add data-regression (hallucination delta >3%) -> manual review.

sre_bot: [metric] us_canary_p95=360ms error=0.08% - starting health window.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] starting US canary at 14:00 UTC

anna: Will monitor 10m stable window then call GO for EU. Pre-stage rollback cmd: `deploybot rollback --slice us --to-version v2.6.1 --reason "canary regression"`.

sre_bot: [log] event us_canary_10m_stable ts=1750012365

anna: GO for EU at 15:40 UTC with reduced concurrency first 20m. APAC mem-safety enabled for canary. Closing thread after EU handoff.
